rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose equivalent when something inspires both fear and deep respect.

example.english: This ancient pagoda can awe people.
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 gu2 taap3 ling6 jan4 ging3 wai3

rows.jyutping: ling6 A jau6 geng1 jau6 ging3
rows.note: Use this conversational construction when emphasizing that A feels both frightened and respectful.

example.traditional: 嗰位將軍令我哋又驚又敬。
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 zoeng1 gwan1 ling6 ngo5 dei6 jau6 geng1 jau6 ging3

rows.note: Use this for a feeling of amazement or wonder, especially at something impressive.

example.english: The detail in this painting fills me with awe.
example.traditional: 呢幅畫嘅細節令人驚嘆。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 waa2 ge3 sai3 zit3 ling6 jan4 ging1 taan3

rows.note: Use this for the all-purpose sense of fear mixed with deep respect or reverence.

example.english: We should always approach nature with awe and reverence.
example.traditional: 我哋對大自然要有敬畏之心。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi3 daai6 zi6 jin4 jiu3 jau5 ging3 wai3 zi1 sam1
